req.title: Return 404 for unknown player ID
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given ID on GET /players/{playerId}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 404 when GET /players/{playerId} is called with a UUID that does not exist in the database. Tests must cover: (1) a positive case confirming a known UUID returns 200, (2) a negative case confirming an unknown UUID returns exactly 404, (3) a boundary case using a syntactically valid UUID that is one character away from a real one (all-zeros UUID, guaranteed absent), and (4) additional mutation-resilient cases asserting the exact status code constant 404 vs 200, and verifying that a malformed UUID returns 422 (not 404), distinguishing the 'not found' path from the 'invalid input' path. All tests use the preloaded fixture data and the in-process FastAPI TestClient.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200
preconditions: Database is preloaded with 26 fixture rows
Player with id '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0' (Franco Armani, squad 1) exists
expected: Response body contains firstName 'Franco' and lastName 'Armani'
trace: R-PLAYER-003: known player ID must return 200 with payload (positive path, EP partition: valid existing UUID)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200():
    known_id = '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{known_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == known_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Franco'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Armani'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1

tests.name: test_get_player_known_then_unknown_status_codes_differ
preconditions: Database is preloaded with 26 fixture rows
UUID '01772c59-43f0-5d85-b913-c78e4e281453' does not exist (last hex digit changed)
expected: The two status codes are not equal
trace: R-PLAYER-003: BVA boundary — UUID differing by one hex digit from a real record must return 404 not 200; catches mutations that ignore UUID comparison or return 200 unconditionally
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_known_then_unknown_status_codes_differ():
    known_id = '01772c59-43f0-5d85-b913-c78e4e281452'
    unknown_id = '01772c59-43f0-5d85-b913-c78e4e281453'
    r_known = client.get(f'/players/{known_id}')
    assert r_known.status_code == 200
    assert r_known.json()['squadNumber'] == 23
    r_unknown = client.get(f'/players/{unknown_id}')
    assert r_unknown.status_code == 404
    assert r_known.status_code != r_unknown.status_code
